 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage follows a structured format consisting of an **Introduction**, a **Main Body**, and a **Conclusion**.
 
• The **Introduction** introduces the process of photosynthesis and its importance.
 
• The **Main Body** explains the two stages of photosynthesis in detail, including the light-dependent and light-independent reactions.
 
• The **Conclusion** summarizes the significance of photosynthesis for life on Earth.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Introduction, Main Body, Conclusion**.

 

**Correct Structure:** *The passage clearly follows the structured format of introduction, detailed explanation, and conclusion, making Option 1 the correct choice.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cause and Effect:** This structure is used when a passage explains reasons and consequences, which is not the case here.
 
• **Compare and Contrast:** This structure is used to highlight similarities and differences, which is not the focus of this passage.
 
• **Problem and Solution:** This structure identifies a problem and proposes solutions, which is not relevant to this passage.
